newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources disappointed by rejection.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources disappointed by rejection.

text.p: Western Resources Inc said it was disappointed by ADT Ltd's rejection of its revised $3.5 billion unsolicited offer.
"We are disappointed with the knee-jerk reaction. We continue to believe ours is still a strong and compelling offer," a Western spokeswoman told Reuters.
She added that Western will move forward with its offer.

Western Resources earlier revised its cash and stock offer of $22.50 per share to give ADT shareholders more cash in the proposed transaction. However, the overall value of the deal was still pegged at $3.5 billion.
ADT quickly said the new offer was inadequate. It also previously had rejected the original offer.
Western Resources owns about 27 percent of ADT shares.
